title: Tenant‑Isolated Cutover Optimizer and Health Sentinel
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Private VPC customers need upgrades to the data plane/runtime without impacting live tenants. Current orchestration can cause transient errors when slices are moved concurrently or when caches are cold. Goal: implement a tenant‑isolated cutover optimizer that sequences tenant delta moves, performs stakeholder‑controlled canaries, and uses a Health Sentinel to gate traffic shifts. The feature must be driven by Terraform modules and include an automated rollback path that is safe for multi-tenant slices.
proposal: Introduce a lightweight sequencer service (Terraform-managed as an optional module) that coordinates per-tenant cutovers. The sequencer will: 1) compute safe batches based on tenant traffic profile and priming state, 2) orchestrate pre-cutover probes and cache warm-start hooks, 3) perform progressive traffic handoff with quorum-based health checks, and 4) publish an immutable cutover record to the ops audit log. Health Sentinel is a configurable policy engine (probe templates + thresholds) that evaluates latency/error/kv-hit metrics from synthetic and real traffic. If Sentinel detects regressions, it triggers a staged rollback plan scoped to affected tenants.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Terraform module deploys sequencer in customer VPC with minimal permissions; 2) Cutover can shift traffic for a tenant slice with <1% error spike and no data loss; 3) Health Sentinel can be tuned via console and gates 3 sequential traffic steps; 4) Automated rollback reverts traffic and clears in-flight probes without leaving half‑primed caches; 5) End-to-end test harness reproduces scenarios and passes in CI.
design_decisions:
- Use lease-based exclusive locks per-tenant to avoid inter-tenant contention.
- Prefer non-blocking probes (synthetic + passive) so client-facing latency remains low.
- Keep sequencer stateless where possible; persist cutover state to an immutable S3/DB snapshot for audit and safe resume.
- Terraform module exposes hooks: pre_warm_script, probe_templates, cutover_window, safety_thresholds.
- Rollback is tenant-scoped first, with global fallback if >25% slices degrade.
rollout_plan:
Phase A (staging): deploy sequencer module to staging VPC, run synthetic canaries across 50 tenants.
Phase B (pilot): run with 5 low-traffic customers for 2 weeks, manually approve cutover windows.
Phase C (opt-in): expose module to Private customers as opt-in terraform feature flag.
Phase D (gradual ramp): enable automated gating + rollback for broader set once telemetry shows stable metrics for 72h.
rollback_playbook:
1) Health Sentinel marks step unhealthy and sets rollback flag.
2) Sequencer pauses new cutovers and marks affected tenant slices for rollback.
3) Route traffic back to previous runtime variant using DNS/Proxy weighted shift in 3 steps (70/30, 90/10, 100/0) with 30s observation windows.
4) If KV cache divergence risk detected, run cache rehydrate/snapshot restore job for the tenant.
5) Create CR for post-mortem, keep cutover record immutable for auditors.
observability:
- Dashboard: per-tenant cutover timeline, probe latency histograms, kv-hit ratio, error rates, and traffic shift progression.
- Alerts: PagerDuty on >5% error increase or missed quorum checks; Ops Slack channel feed for cutover lifecycle events.
- Logs: cutover records (immutable), probe traces, terraform apply diffs attached to cutover event.
testing_plan:
- Unit tests for sequencer lease and state transitions.
- Integration: end-to-end with Terraform plan/apply in a sandboxed VPC.
- Fault injection: simulate node reboots, high latency, and KV churn during cutovers.
- Regression: run against the existing rollback harness and ensure no stale routing remains.
- CI: gated by nightly e2e matrix (small/medium/large tenant profiles).
tasks: Design sequencer terraform module and IAM policy doc
Implement sequencer service (Go) with lease + state persistence
Add Health Sentinel probe templates and console controls
Create terraform examples and customer opt-in guide
Integrate cutover audit events with observability pipeline
Write e2e tests and chaos scenarios
Run pilot with 5 customers and collect telemetry
Document rollback playbook and runbook in Confluence
risks: Cache divergence when switching back quickly
Terraform state drift in multi-account setups
Edge cases where passive probes miss cold-start regressions
Customer networks with strict egress blocking affecting probe reachability
dependencies_notes: Depends on infra work in ENG-472301 for safe routing primitives and ENG-412356 for synthetic traffic harness. Also needs Console feature flip to expose gating controls to customers.
